audit_items.proof_trace: refund() always transfers exactly the current investedCapital (line 176), which equals the original investment unless withdrawExcessInvestedCapital was called first. If an investor voluntarily calls withdrawExcessInvestedCapital before refund(), investedCapital is reduced by the excess amount already returned to them; the total recovery (excess + remaining investedCapital) equals the original investment, so no funds are lost. The formal assertion is overly strict — it does not account for prior excess withdrawals that already returned part of the investor's capital.
